summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 9h 35m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five AE orders reported stuck in shipping. Four confirmed COMPLETED per latest comment. One order (AE260812-57849665) remains stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED with partial cancellation and delivery completed. Investigation continues with parallel Kibana and DB analysis. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two AE trade-in orders had automatic clawback triggered by NorthLadder cronjob. Checkout.com declined both clawback payments (2230 and 2195 AED). Orders COMPLETED but clawback stuck at payment step. Awaiting customer card update confirmation. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation initiated for GMT-20796. RCA not yet written — only residual EOD generation logs present in file. Investigation in progress, awaiting completion of parallel analysis across Kibana, codebase, and DB state verification. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess

RT-702249 — [SEMAG] [STG2] - Trade-up SO Failure

SAHME-3357 — 
  Fourteen ZA SC+ orders investigated. Eleven remediated with ExternalService UPDATED. Three remain in ERROR — unmapped A36 device model, invalid identity document, and unmapped product ID. All blocked on SMC-side mappings. Awaiting Subs team confirmation before retrigger. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  RCA file not found in ticket-rca directory. Investigation not yet started or RCA not generated. Only nearby lock file SAHME-3409 exists. Remains pending — no investigation output available for summarization. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — Request to allocate 0.01 to the accessory SKU
  Investigation initiated but RCA not yet written — only residual EOD generation logs present in file. Investigation in progress, awaiting completion of parallel analysis across Kibana, codebase trace, and DB state verification.

SAME-3958 — 
  SA sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. Groovy script needs two new @ColumnMethod handlers — Order model already has getters. Infrastructure fully exists. Script update needed, no build required for dynamic Groovy loading. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — Order Refund Failed - Manual Refund
  Investigation launched for 18 SA-region orders with refund failures. Sub-agent fan-out initiated across Kibana, DB state, codebase trace, and Jira cross-reference. Ticket details fetched confirming refund trigger scope. Parallel investigations in progress.

Open tickets:

RT-702249 [New] — [SEMAG] [STG2] - Trade-up SO Failure
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAME-3962 [In Progress] — Order Refund Failed - Manual Refund
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAHME-3421 [In Progress] — Request to allocate 0.01 to the accessory SKU
  Todo: Continue investigation.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
